name: Hudiesaurus
sum: Hudiesaurus is a mamenchisaurid sauropod from the Late Jurassic of Xinjiang, China, based on a single vertebra.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: A single vertebra, first read as a dorsal and later as one of the last neck vertebrae.
material: Teeth and limb bones assigned by Dong from a nearby locality were reassigned to another genus in 2021.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Dong 1997

sources.text: Upchurch P, Mannion PD, Xu X, Barrett PM 2021. Re-assessment of the Late Jurassic eusauropod dinosaur ''Hudiesaurus sinojapanorum'' Dong, 1997, from the Turpan Basin, China, and the evolution of hyper-robust antebrachia in sauropods. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 41(4). doi:10.1080/02724634.2021.1994414
